caption: Avg. accuracy across 11 datasets (y-axis) for each training method (x-axis)

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average performance across five different methods. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled as "Standard," "Self-RAG," "FactTune," "ClInGS (w/)," and "ClInGS." The categories are presented in this specific order without any indication of sorting by value or name. The vertical axis represents the "Average Performance," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60, marked at intervals of 10 units. Each bar represents a method and is distinctively colored: "Standard" in orange with an approximate value of 52, "Self-RAG" in beige around 53, "FactTune" in light green also near 51, "ClInGS (w/)" in light blue approximately at 52, and "ClInGS" in blue with the tallest value of about 58. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there are no additional visual emphases such as shading or outlines.
